string-array.name: help_oil_temp
string-array.item: Engine oil temperature. Oil warms up much more slowly than coolant.
We don\'t know GM\'s operating limits for this engine. While the oil is cold, better not to rev the engine high — a general rule for any engine.
Watch the trend: if on your usual route the oil runs noticeably hotter than before, check the oil level and the cooling.

string-array.name: help_oil_pressure
string-array.item: Oil pressure, a GM parameter. Formula from a single source, not verified on a car.
We don\'t know the pressure norms for this engine. Pressure rises with RPM and drops with hot oil — general physics.
Until the formula is verified, we draw no conclusions from this number. The oil pressure light on the cluster is the main signal: if it comes on, shut the engine off at once.

string-array.name: help_oil_life
string-array.item: Remaining oil life from the GM Oil Life system. It\'s not a sensor: oil life is calculated from how the engine runs — RPM and temperature.
After an oil change it is reset to 100%, then it decreases. This parameter\'s formula is unverified — compare with what the cluster shows.
If it wasn\'t reset after an oil change, the counter means nothing — go by mileage.
